description:
AI Engineer 
  
 Location: Austin Texas. 
 Type: Fixed Term Employee (6 months with possible extension, including Benefits). 
  
 Job Summary 
 The AI Engineer will play a key role in driving data-driven decision-making and intelligent automation within our organization. You will be responsible for the architectural design, optimization, and deployment of Agentic AI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs/SLMs). Focusing on building robust pipelines, optimizing model performance for specific hardware constraints, and developing sophisticated agent orchestration frameworks, you will solve complex business automation challenges 
 Responsibilities 
 AI System Architecture & Implementation: 
 Model Deployment & Optimization: Lead the end-to-end integration of machine learning models and fine-tuned SLMs into production environments, focusing on model compression, latency reduction, and hardware-specific optimization. 
 Agentic Workflows: Design and implement autonomous agent architectures, including multi-step reasoning engines, tool-use integration, and structured decision-making frameworks. 
 Efficient Fine-Tuning Implementation: Develop and maintain the infrastructure for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), implementing techniques like LoRA, QLoRA, or Adapter-tuning to minimize computational overhead. 
 Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG): Build and maintain high-performance vector databases and semantic search indices to enable context-aware AI responses and sub-second data retrieval. 
 Data Engineering & Pipeline Development: 

 Automated Data Pipelines: Develop scalable, automated pipelines for the cleaning, normalization, and feature engineering of high-velocity raw data streams. 
 Quality Assurance: Collaborate with Data Scientists to establish "Ground Truth" datasets and implement automated validation layers to ensure model output reliability and safety. 
 System Monitoring: Design and implement monitoring solutions to track model drift, inference performance, and resource utilization in production. 
 Technical Leadership & Integration: 

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless transition from model prototype to hardened production binary. Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and code reviews for junior engineers, championing best practices in software engineering and AI deployment. 
 Stakeholder Engagement & Consulting: Translate complex technical constraints (e.g., memory limits, inference speed) into clear trade-offs for client stakeholders and project leadership. 
 
  
 Eligibility Requirements 
 Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with a proven track record of deploying AI models in production. 
 Technical Stack (Expert Level): Languages: Expert proficiency in Python; familiarity with lower-level languages (C++/Rust) or Go for performance-critical components is preferred. 
 AI Frameworks: Deep experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX, and libraries for model adaptation and inference (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem). 
 Data Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, Vector Databases, and cloud-native AI services (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 
 
 Engineering Rigor: Demonstrated mastery of version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API design (REST/gRPC). 
 Problem Solving: Proven ability to optimize models for restricted resource environments (memory, CPU/GPU limits) without compromising core performance. 
 PEFT & Adaptability: Deep experience with PEFT libraries (e.g., Hugging Face PEFT) and fine-tuning frameworks 
  
 Preferred Qulification 
 Experience working in a cross-functional and client-facing team environment within an outsourcing or consulting framework. 
 Familiarity with workflow automation and enterprise analytics tools (e.g., Alteryx, advanced BI pipelines). 
  
 Core Competencies 
 Technical depth with client-facing communication 
 Systems thinking and compatibility validation 
 Precision and process discipline 
  
 In the US, the target base salary for this role is $175,000-$180,000. Compensation is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and geography. We expect the majority of candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall throughout the range based on these factors 
  
 About eClerx 
 eClerx is a leading provider of productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results.​ 

 The firm provides business process management, automation, and analytics services to a number of Fortune 2000 enterprises, including some of the world’s leading financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, and technology companies.
